parameters.content:
### 🛒 TikTok Shop Viral Product & Inventory Radar

**Purpose:**
Automates daily discovery of winning TikTok Shop products by keyword, calculates sales velocity, and deep-inspects the #1 winner's live SKU warehouse stock levels.

**Target Audience:**
Dropshippers, E-commerce store owners, Amazon/eBay arbitrage scouts.

### 🔑 Apify Setup & Free Credits

1. Connect your **Apify API Account**.
2. Uses fast SSR actors with **zero browser overhead**.
3. Every Apify user gets **$5 monthly free credits** (~2,500 products free/mo).

### 🔔 Integrations

Connect the output of **Format Daily Alert** to:
- **Slack / Telegram / Discord** for daily morning winner alerts
- **Google Sheets / Notion** for product research database
- **Email / Make / Zapier** for automated inventory notifications

### 🌐 Apify Actors Used in This Workflow

1. 🔍 **[TikTok Shop Search Scraper](https://apify.com/magic-scraper/tiktok-shop-search-scraper)**
   - Extracts trending products, sold counts, live prices, discounts, and seller ratings by keyword.
   - Pricing: $2.00 / 1,000 products ($0.002/item).

2. 📦 **[TikTok Shop Product Scraper](https://apify.com/magic-scraper/tiktok-shop-product-scraper)**
   - Extracts complete SKU variant matrix, real-time live numerical warehouse stock, specs, and verified reviews.
   - Pricing: $2.00 / 1,000 products.

3. 🎬 **[TikTok Video & Hashtag Scraper](https://apify.com/magic-scraper/tiktok-video-hashtag-scraper)**
   - Extracts viral videos, creator engagement metrics, hashtags, sounds, and affiliate shop indicators.
   - Pricing: $2.00 / 1,000 videos.

💡 *Every Apify user receives **$5 free credits every month**, allowing ~2,500 free items/mo.*

## TikTok Shop Viral Product & Inventory Tracker

### How it works

This workflow runs either manually or every day at 9 AM to scrape TikTok Shop bestseller data through Apify. It analyzes the scraped products to select a likely winning product, then checks SKU stock and review details before formatting a daily alert message.

### Setup steps

- Configure the Apify credentials used by both Apify nodes.
- Set the TikTok Shop scraping actor and any required input parameters in the bestseller scraping node.
- Verify the daily schedule trigger timezone and 9 AM run time.
- Review the custom code that scores or selects the winning product, and confirm the final alertMessage field matches the destination where it will be used.

### Customization

Adjust the product selection logic, stock/review inspection criteria, or alert message format to match your product niche and reporting needs.

## Trigger product scrape

Contains the manual and scheduled entry points plus the nearby Apify scrape step that collects TikTok Shop bestseller data.

## Evaluate product details

Analyzes the scraped bestseller list to pick a winning product, then inspects SKU-level inventory and review information through another Apify call.

## Format daily alert

Formats the final daily alert message from the selected product and inventory review results.
